run_relicense_script: run the python relicense script on a directory to replace LGPL3 headers with MPL2 headers
update_license_header: call the update function to replace an LGPL3 license header with an MPL2 header in text
review_update_function: review the update function that checks for LGPL3 headers and replaces them with MPL2
refactor_relicense_exclusions: refactor the relicense script exclusions set to add more files to skip during license replacement
test_update_function: test the update function with sample text containing an LGPL3 license header
